redfin.remarks: Updated 2BR/2BA Fox Hills condo offering approx. 1,265 SF in a quiet rear location with peaceful treetop views. Freshly painted and move-in ready with smooth ceilings, recessed LED lighting, newer COREtec waterproof/pet-proof LVP flooring, central A/C and heat, and a new electric fireplace with granite mantel. The kitchen and baths have been updated, making this a turn key unit. Additional features are a granite-topped mini bar and LED ceiling fan in the kitchen nook. En-suite primary has a walk-in closet; second bedroom features large mirrored closet doors. Electrical upgrades include Decora-style outlets/switches and an upgraded panel with surge protector. One assigned parking space, ample street parking and garage storage. HOA amenities include pool, spa, sauna, community laundry, earthquake insurance, internet, Spectrum cable, water/trash and more. Convenient to Fox Hills Park, Westfield Culver City, Silicon Beach and the 405.
